question: For $A=\begin{bmatrix}1&2&3\\0&4&5\\2&1&6\end{bmatrix}$, find the cofactor $A_{23}$.
explanation:
Step 1: Use the cofactor relation
The cofactor of the element in the $i$th row and $j$th column is $$A_{ij}=(-1)^{i+j}M_{ij}$$
Step 2: Form the minor
Deleting the second row and third column gives $$M_{23}=\begin{vmatrix}1&2\\2&1\end{vmatrix}=1-4=-3$$
Step 3: Determine the sign
Since $2+3=5$ is odd, $$(-1)^{2+3}=-1$$
Step 4: Calculate the cofactor
Therefore, $$A_{23}=(-1)(-3)=3$$
Hence, the required cofactor is $A_{23}=3$.
